classes.label: Brown Dwarf
classes.description: A substellar object too light to sustain hydrogen fusion in its core.

classes.label: Red Dwarf
classes.description: A small, cool, very long-lived main-sequence star -- the most common type in the galaxy.

classes.label: White Dwarf
classes.description: The dense, Earth-sized remnant left behind when a Sun-like star exhausts its fuel.

classes.label: Main Sequence
classes.description: A star fusing hydrogen in its core, like our own Sun.

classes.label: Supergiant
classes.description: A massive, extremely luminous evolved star, hundreds of times the Sun's radius.

classes.label: Hypergiant
classes.description: The rarest and most luminous stars known, shedding mass at enormous rates.
